digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate overlay (T13) and surface-parity criterion
propositions: T13 plan-review overlay currently triggers only on newly-forbidden actions (prohibitions), not newly-added obligations (contracts, invariants, schema fields, required arguments, multi-site constraints), leaving a measurable class of cross-file obligation misses undetected.

The widened surface-parity criterion (content-triggered on CLI argument changes + NDJSON/import channel) would exhibit ~70% false-positive rate over historical commits, matching the precedent omitted-scope-site class profile, because most CLI-only changes owe no MCP/NDJSON parity.

Operator approved P2 (widen T13 lexicon from prohibition to obligation) as minimal-value prompt edit; P0 (import-integrity) resolved as deterministic import-walk task; P1 (surface-parity FP assessment) confirmed via 40-commit sample showing 10% TP rate and single-family origin; P3 (project.obligation-parity overlay) rejected; ci-gate-compat criterion rejected per prior operator ruling (6f2e-58a5).

The deterministic pre-gate regex in det_gate_rules.py must be extended with additive-obligation vocabulary branch (new alternation carrying 'must stay in sync', 'new contract', 'adds required') to prevent T13 router-unreachability; audit-verbatim enforcement branch remains unchanged.

Write-parameter parity across library/CLI/MCP surfaces is now covered deterministically by the tests/interfaces/write_parity_contract.py oracle (added post-bug-1128 fix 2026-08-18), eliminating the LLM criterion's demonstrated TP family; any residual NDJSON/import parity gaps should be extended into the oracle rather than triggering new advisory overlays.
